notes.title: How to change your language settings for the game
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

For those who are experiencing a problem with setting up the language 
which you want to play in, please follow the steps shown below;


1) First, uninstall the game. Ensure that ALL settings in your Steam platform are in Traditional Chinese, not in English.

2) Go to your HP and go to "Library"
3) Right click on "Root Letter Last Answer"
4) Go to "Properties" shown at the bottom of the list. Left click it.
5) Find the "Language" tab at the top of the window. Left click it.
6) Pull down and choose "Traditional Chinese"
7) Go back to the game and re-install it.

We apologize for this inconvenience.

notes.title: How to find your Art Book (Exclusive Perk for Root Letter Last Answer)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

If you’re having a hard time finding your Art Book, please follow the simple steps below;

1) Go to your own HP in Steam
2) Go to your “Library” and go to your “Games” 
3) Choose and click (right click) on “Root Letter Last Answer” 
4) Click on “Properties”
5) Click on the “Local Files” tab shown on the upper side of the window
6) Click on “Browse Local Files”
7) You will see the file for the “Art Book”
